description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Formatter' used for formatting SCSS code within the SCSSPHP library. It includes properties and methods for handling indentation, property assignment, block rendering, source map integration, and output management.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for specific SCSS formatting implementations, managing output structure, source map integration, and formatting logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Abstract constructor method to initialize formatter instances.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the string representing indentation, defaulting to empty, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Creates a CSS property assignment string.

methods.name: customProperty
methods.description: Creates a custom property assignment string, preserving spaces in the value.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs lines within a block, managing indentation and line joins.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Outputs an entire block, including selectors, lines, and children.

methods.name: testEmptyChildren
methods.description: Recursively tests and cleans empty children within a block.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main entry point for formatting a block with optional source map generation.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs a string, handling semicolon stripping and source map updates.
